text:
maria: FYI PR #4123 is stuck on merge — failing integ shard with kv cache test flake. anyone can take a quick look? https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/4123
ci-bot: Build failed on integ-3 • kv_cache_integ_test.TestKVCacheEviction • exit 1 • logs: https://ci.redwood/builds/8899/logs
aj: I can grab logs, gimme a min.
maria: here's the failing tail:
```
E 14:02:03 TestKVCacheEviction: timeout waiting for eviction after 30s
E AssertionError: expected evicted == true
E   at tests/kv/test_eviction.py:87
```
simon: that's the nondet eviction flake we've seen. usually shows up under shard saturation. what was the worker count?
maria: shard3, 8 workers. repro rate locally ~1/20 when I stress loop it.
ying: please don't update snapshots for this one. can we do a targeted rerun on integ-3 only? pinging @evan to queue it.
evon: queued targeted rerun for integ-3: https://ci.redwood/targeted/8901 — added label `ci/flake`. (evan)
ci-bot: Targeted rerun started (build 8901).
aj: if rerun is green do we want to merge or wait for another pass? i'm leaning 2 green runs unless it's test-only.
maria: no product code change, just flaky test. i'll open a follow-up issue to add a retry wrapper and link it in the PR. if 8901 is green, feel free to approve + merge.
simon: note for follow-up: consider reducing shard concurrency or introducing deterministic seeds for eviction timing.
evon: :thumbsup: watching 8901.
ci-bot: Build 8901: PASSED on integ-3. All tests green.
aj: ok going to merge after CI propagation — tagging @oncall in case it flaps again.
maria: thanks all. i'll file the flaky-test ticket and add repro steps in the PR.
